gholam.text:
رفقا، بن نورتون توی شبکه ایکس درباره برکناری جنسن هوانگ، مدیرعامل انویدیا، ادعا کرده که این اتفاق یه «کودتای شرکتی» با حمایت جریان‌های تندرو علیه چین توی واشنگتن بوده. او برای این موضوع به چند تا گزارش از رسانه‌های آمریکایی استناد کرده:
• به نوشته واشنگتن‌پست، مارکو روبیو یکی از چهره‌های اصلی پشت این ماجرا بوده و با تکیه بر یه گزارش سیا، فشار آورده تا علیه هوانگ که به نظرش در برابر چین زیادی ملایم بوده، اقدام بشه.
• از اون طرف، سی‌ان‌ان گزارش داده مقام‌های سیا بعداً اعتراف کردن هیچ مدرکی نیست که نشون بده آلیس هوانگ (تاجر چینی که جنسن هوانگ باهاش رابطه داشته) جاسوس چین بوده.
• رسانه سمافور هم جداگانه نوشته یه گروه دوحزبی از سیاستمدارهای سخت‌گیر علیه چین پشت کارزار برکناری هوانگ بودن و حالا بعد از رسیدن به خواسته‌شون، دنبال سیاست‌های تهاجمی‌تر آمریکا علیه چین و به‌خصوص محدودیت‌های صادراتی سخت‌تر هستن.

links.text:
The ouster of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was a corporate coup backed by China hawks in Washington:

The Washington Post reported that Marco Rubio was one of the key figures behind the coup against Huang.

The Washington Post wrote that "Huang’s downfall ... was ultimately set in motion by ... Marco Rubio".

Rubio, a longtime neoconservative hawk, used a CIA report to push for action against Huang, whom he targeted for being too soft on China.

(Source: https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/2026/11/13/behind-jensen-huangs-spy-scandal-shadow-war-trumps-ear-china/)

CIA officials have since admitted to CNN that there is no evidence that the Chinese businesswoman with whom Jensen Huang had an affair, Alice Huang, is a Chinese spy.

(Source: https://edition.cnn.com/2026/11/12/politics/alice-huang-us-intel-jensen-huang-nvidia)

Separately, Semafor also reported that a bipartisan group of China hawks in Washington were behind the campaign to remove Huang as CEO. They succeeded.

Now these hawks are pushing for more aggressive US policies against China, especially tighter export restrictions.

quote.text:
It's now obvious that US intelligence agencies carried out another coup, but not against a foreign head of state this time, but rather against Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

First, US spies and China hawks spread the unsubstantiated rumor that the Chinese businesswoman with whom he had an affair, Alice Huang, was a spy.

Next, they forced him to resign.

Now, US spies are acknowledging that there is no evidence that she is a spy. But they don't care, because they accomplished their goal: removing Jensen Huang.

Who benefits? China hawks and Silicon Valley monopolists.

China hawks have been demanding much harsher US policies against China, as part of the chip war / tech war / Cold War Two. Jensen Huang had lobbied hard against these (because he and Nvidia profited, of course).

Some US Big Tech corporations also benefit, because Jensen Huang had been an outspoken advocate of open-source AI models. OpenAI and Anthropic have been lobbying the US government to ban these, because Chinese open-source models are much cheaper and more competitive, and have been eating their lunch.
